oncall-bot: P1 ALERT — embeddings-service: elevated latency and 5xx rate in eu-west-1. Incident INC-20251204-237. Paging #eng-oncall. metrics: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/embeddings

Maya R: I'm primary for this shift, I'll take driver unless someone else wants it. quick triage first?

David L: I'm secondary. I can pick up comms if needed, but Eric's available and faster at customer notes.

Maya R: OK taking driver. first check: prefix cache miss % jumped at 02:10 UTC, redis KPIs spiking. no obvious infra alerts besides latency.

Samir K: I can look at the model host pool and deployment state. I saw a canary roll at 02:15 UTC yesterday. pulling logs now.

Lina T: FYI I saw a transient increase in replication lag on redis-eu-1 at 02:09. could be correlated. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/embeddings_latency_runbook

Maya R: Plan — (1) Samir validate deploy vs rollback candidate, (2) David/Eric prepare comms, (3) Lina validate redis cluster health and flag any node restarts. If driver needs fallback, we will route traffic to lower-capacity pool.

Samir K: running quick check:
```
# list recent deploys for embeddings-service
kubectl -n prod get deploy embeddings-service -o json | jq '.status.conditions[]'
# check canary pods
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=embeddings-service,canary=true
```

Samir K: Confirmed canary was rolled at 2025-12-04T02:15Z. Pod restarts count = 0, but one canary has OOM_kill in previous day. digging into model lib logs.

Lina T: I'm checking redis cluster: primary nodes show CPU spike ~80% at 02:09 and io wait high on node eu-redis-3. Putting node in read-only? Not yet.

Eric C: I'll own external comms. Drafting status page blurb now. Suggest: "We are investigating increased latency and errors impacting embeddings in EU-West. No data loss expected. Engineers are actively investigating."

David L: Eric - add affected customers list link: https://internal.crm/active-eu-customers and ping AE/Support slack. I'll patch in updates every 15 mins.

Maya R: Ownership assignment: Maya R = driver (triage + mitigation), Samir K = infra/model lead (rollback / deploy checks), Lina T = infra (redis), Eric C = comms owner, David L = secondary / escalation bridge. If incident runs past 04:00 UTC, we need a formal shift swap — @Lina T please confirm availability to take driver at that time.

Lina T: I can take the driver at 04:00 UTC if needed. current ETA for deeper redis dig ~20-30m.

Maya R: Good. Quick mitigation attempt: reduce embedding request concurrency on the canary nodes and enable prefix-KV cache fallback. Samir — do you have a safe command to lower concurrency?

Samir K: yes, applying temporary config:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/embeddings-service MAX_CONCURRENCY=8 --record
# then monitor tail latency
```
Applying now.

Maya R: Eric - status page draft posted, please include next update schedule (T+15m). Tagging @support-team and @ae-eu.

Eric C: Posted. Customers notified: "Investigating performance degradation for embeddings in EU-West. Engineers actively working. Next update in 15 minutes." Added impact: "latency spikes and intermittent 5xx for embedding endpoints; developer SDKs may see timeouts."

David L: Noted. Logging the assignment in the incident doc. filling in the 'owners' section.

Maya R: Current action items recap: driver=Maya (lead), infra/model=Samir, redis=Lina, comms=Eric, bridge=David. Runbook link above. If we need rollback I'll call it and Samir will execute. Everyone react with :thumbsup: when you have the action.

oncall-bot: Acknowledged assignments. Incident channel created: #incident-INC-20251204-237

Maya R: :thumbsup:
Samir K: :thumbsup:
Lina T: :thumbsup:
Eric C: :thumbsup:
David L: :thumbsup:

Maya R: I'll post the next note at T+10 once initial mitigation finishes. keep comms tight and please call out any coverage gaps: current gap is midnight-swap at 04:00 UTC which Lina has agreed to cover if needed.

David L: I'll prepare a short escalation play if rollback fails (pager to infra-sre lead).

Maya R: Thanks team. moving to triage.
